- The Pelicans roster is crowded, with Derik Queen also at center and Zion Williamson used at center with success last season. That puts his minutes at risk. - Experts and a Pelicans beat reporter expect him to start at center over Derik Queen. (verdict, 2026-10-10; [10-10](https://youtu.be/gsx_UDkVPd0?t=931), [10-02](https://youtu.be/ZYllcj4o6_A?t=1324), [09-30](https://youtu.be/BjXP9JODDSg?t=1097), [09-24](https://youtu.be/_vbAP5y182A?t=1144), [08-03](https://youtu.be/5QU-jta-lWM?t=1467), [09-30](https://youtu.be/BjXP9JODDSg?t=1097), [09-24](https://youtu.be/_vbAP5y182A?t=1141))
- As a starter he is expected to shoot in the mid-50s from the field with about two blocks and 7 to 8 rebounds, and one expert sees upside for double-digit rebounds. (verdict, 2026-10-10; [10-10](https://youtu.be/gsx_UDkVPd0?t=971), [10-02](https://youtu.be/ZYllcj4o6_A?t=1324))
- At a Yahoo ADP of about 124 he is a fine late-round flyer. (verdict, 2026-10-10; [10-10](https://youtu.be/gsx_UDkVPd0?t=931), [10-02](https://youtu.be/ZYllcj4o6_A?t=1324))
- New Orleans plays 4, 4 and 3 games in our playoff weeks 19 to 21, which is a good schedule. (fact, 2026-10-10; [10-10](https://youtu.be/gsx_UDkVPd0?t=1973))
- New Orleans has a league-high 16 back-to-backs. (fact, 2026-10-10; [10-10](https://youtu.be/gsx_UDkVPd0?t=2032))
- Under new coach Jamahl Mosley he is the Pelican most likely to get a much bigger role. (verdict, 2026-08-03; [08-03](https://youtu.be/5QU-jta-lWM?t=1467))
- Mosley switches less than the previous coach, which could help his weak defensive rebounding. (verdict, 2026-08-03; [08-03](https://youtu.be/5QU-jta-lWM?t=1482), [08-03](https://youtu.be/5QU-jta-lWM?t=1459))
- Experts see the Pelicans as a weak team near the bottom of the West, at about 34 wins. (verdict, 2026-08-03; [07-27](https://youtu.be/0AptxcRW0RE?t=2060), [08-03](https://youtu.be/5QU-jta-lWM?t=1765))

**Durable**
- Blocks are a league-level strength. He makes no threes and gets very few steals. (fact, 2026-10-16; stats)
- His fantasy value comes from blocks and FG% on very low usage. One expert compares him to a Mitchell Robinson type. (verdict, 2026-10-10; [10-10](https://youtu.be/gsx_UDkVPd0?t=971), stats)
- He is a strong rim protector who contests many shots at the rim and turns a high share of them into blocks. (fact, 2026-08-03; [08-03](https://youtu.be/5QU-jta-lWM?t=1450), [07-17](https://youtu.be/NYTH7uQsPCM?t=623))
- He is a poor defensive rebounder for a center, around the bottom 10% at his position. (fact, 2026-08-03; [08-03](https://youtu.be/5QU-jta-lWM?t=1482))
